Long John Silver Menu: Explore the Best Seafood Combos for Every Budget

Long John Silver’s offers a variety of delicious, seafood-focused dishes at affordable prices. With hand-battered fish, shrimp platters, grilled options, and family meals, there’s something for everyone on the menu. In this guide, we’ll explore the best seafood combos, menu items, and provide detailed information, including pricing tables. Plus, we’ll show you how to order online for delivery or takeout.

Long John Silver Menu: Affordable Seafood for Every Taste

If you love seafood and are looking for the best menu deals, Long John Silver’s is the perfect place to satisfy your cravings. With a wide variety of menu items like the classic battered fish, shrimp, and grilled options, the restaurant has something for every seafood lover. This article provides a detailed overview of the menu, including pricing, combo offers, and ways to order online or for takeout. For tips on choosing healthy seafood, check out the Seafood Nutrition Partnership’s Healthy Seafood Guide or read the FDA’s advice on eating fish.

Signature Combos on the Long John Silver Menu

Long John Silver’s is known for its combo meals, which provide a great way to enjoy a variety of seafood at affordable prices. These signature combos often include fish, shrimp, and all-white meat chicken paired with sides like fries and hushpuppies.

Combo Price Included Items
Fish & Chicken Combo $7.99 One piece of classic battered Alaska Pollock, two all-white meat chicken, fries, hushpuppies, and a drink
Fish & Shrimp Combo $8.49 Two pieces of Alaska Pollock, three battered shrimp, fries, hushpuppies, and a drink
Shrimp & Chicken Combo $7.49 Three pieces of battered shrimp, two all-white meat chicken, fries, hushpuppies, and a drink
Grilled Salmon Combo $9.99 One grilled salmon fillet, seasoned rice, steamed veggies, and a drink

These combos allow you to mix and match menu items for a complete meal.

Family Meals – Great for Sharing

For those dining with a group, Long John Silver’s family meals provide great value. These meals are perfect for sharing with family or friends, offering large portions of fish, chicken, and sides to feed multiple people. If you’re interested in sustainable seafood choices, you can learn more through the Marine Stewardship Council and see how responsible fishing practices help keep seafood affordable and plentiful.

Family Meal Price Included Items
8-Piece Family Meal $19.99 8 pieces of Alaska Pollock or all-white meat chicken, 2 large sides, and 8 hushpuppies
10-Piece Family Meal $24.99 10 pieces of fish or chicken, 3 large sides, and 10 hushpuppies
16-Piece Family Meal $39.99 16 pieces of fish and chicken, 4 large sides, and 16 hushpuppies

With plenty of sides to choose from, including fries, coleslaw, and more, these meals make it easy to share your seafood favorites with others.

Long John Silver’s Menu: Best Seafood Platter Options

For those who want to enjoy multiple menu items in one meal, the seafood platters at Long John Silver’s are the way to go. These platters feature a combination of fish, shrimp, chicken, and classic sides like hushpuppies and fries.

Platter Price Included Items
Fish & Shrimp Platter $9.99 2 pieces of Alaska Pollock, 4 pieces of battered shrimp, 2 hushpuppies, fries, and coleslaw
Chicken Platter $8.49 3 pieces of all-white meat chicken, 2 hushpuppies, fries, and coleslaw
Grilled Shrimp & Salmon Platter $11.99 Grilled shrimp, grilled salmon, seasoned rice, steamed vegetables

Platters are ideal for those who want to taste a bit of everything and experience the full range of flavors that Long John Silver’s menu has to offer.

Grilled Seafood for a Healthier Option

For those seeking lighter, healthier options, Long John Silver’s grilled seafood selections are perfect. These meals feature grilled shrimp and salmon, served with nutritious sides like rice and steamed vegetables. If you’d like to explore how grilled seafood can fit into a balanced diet.

Grilled Menu Item Price Included Items
Grilled Salmon Meal $9.99 Grilled salmon, rice, steamed vegetables, and a side of tartar sauce
Grilled Shrimp Meal $8.99 Grilled shrimp, rice, steamed vegetables, and a side of tartar sauce

These grilled meals are lower in calories compared to the fried options, making them a popular choice for health-conscious customers.

Tacos at Long John Silver’s – A Flavorful Twist

Long John Silver’s also offers unique and delicious seafood tacos. These tacos feature perfectly fried Alaskan Pollock or grilled shrimp, topped with Baja sauce and fresh slaw, wrapped in soft taco shells.

Taco Price Included Items
Fish Taco $2.99 Fried Alaskan Pollock, fresh slaw, Baja sauce, soft taco shell
Shrimp Taco $3.49 Grilled shrimp, slaw, Baja sauce, soft taco shell
Baja Fish Taco Combo $6.99 2 fish tacos, fries, and a drink

These tacos offer a delicious, flavorful twist on traditional seafood and are perfect for a quick meal.

Order Long John Silver’s Online for Delivery or Pickup

Ordering your favorite seafood meals has never been easier. Long John Silver’s offers the option to order online through their official website or third-party delivery services. You can browse the menu, customize your order, and choose to have it delivered or ready for pickup.

Delivery Option Available Through
Official Website Long John Silver’s Website
Delivery Apps DoorDash, Uber Eats, GrubHub
Free Delivery Promotions Available at certain locations
  • Delivery fee varies based on location, and takeout is available if you prefer to pick up your meal.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: Does Long John Silver’s have grilled seafood options?
A: Yes, Long John Silver’s offers several grilled options, including grilled shrimp and grilled salmon meals, served with healthy sides.

Q: What sides can I get with my meal?
A: Popular sides include hushpuppies, fries, coleslaw, steamed vegetables, and seasoned rice.

Q: Does Long John Silver’s offer family meals?
A: Yes, family meals are available with large portions of fish, chicken, and sides. These meals are great for sharing.

Q: Can I order Long John Silver’s for delivery?
A: Yes, you can easily order online for delivery through the Long John Silver’s website or delivery apps like DoorDash and Uber Eats.

Conclusion – Find the Best Deals at Long John Silver’s

Whether you’re craving fried fish, grilled shrimp, or a tasty seafood taco, Long John Silver’s has a menu full of great options at affordable prices. From individual combos to family meals, there’s something for everyone. You can easily order online for delivery or pickup, making it more convenient than ever to enjoy your favorite seafood dishes.
